Đặt lịch làm đẹp ở Việt Nam vẫn còn là c: Booking a beauty appointment in Vietnam still means messages, phone calls and price lists nobody is sure about. Customers lose time asking around, and salons lose customers simply because one message slipped through.
OAK Beauty ra đời để xóa bỏ khoảng cách: OAK Beauty exists to close that gap: one place where you can clearly see each salon's services, prices, durations and open time slots, then book in seconds.

Mô tả nhu cầu bằng tiếng Việt tự nhiên —: Describe what you need in everyday Vietnamese — "men's haircut District 3", "relaxing massage under 500k" — or browse by category: nails, hair, skincare, spa and eyelashes.
Chọn dịch vụ, chuyên viên và khung giờ c: Choose your service, your specialist and an open time slot. Some salons confirm the moment you book and some look at it first — the booking page says which this one does, and you are told in Notifications either way; every booking sits in My appointments for you to track, change or cancel.
Đến salon đúng giờ, thanh toán trực tiếp: Arrive at the salon on time and pay directly at the counter. After your visit, you can leave a review to help the community find the right place.
Mỗi salon niêm yết công khai giá, thời l: Every salon lists the price, the duration and the opening hours of each service in the open; reviews come only from appointments that were completed.
Giá và thời lượng của từng dịch vụ được: The price and duration of every service are listed openly. No hidden fees, no deposits up front.
Chỉ khách đã hoàn thành lịch hẹn mới đượ: Only customers who have completed an appointment can leave a review, so ratings reflect genuine experiences.
